title: Miami-based Canals, which uses AI to help distributors automate workflows across sales, customer service, and more, raised a $35M Series A led by Base10 (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Miami-based Canals, which uses AI to help distributors automate workflows across sales, customer service, and more, raised a $35M Series A led by Base10 — Canals raised a $35 million Series A led by Base10 Partners, CEO Michael Delgado tells Axios Pro exclusively.
